korean_equities.public_official_price_source: KRX Open API catalog describes daily stock/ETF data from 2010-01-04; production access requires account, API key, service request, and administrator approval.
korean_equities.inactive_and_delisted_history: KRX pages expose delisting status and price-history components, but a complete reproducible bulk PIT universe and adjusted total-return series were not verified.

us_equities.free_official_sources: Nasdaq offers individual historical quote pages; SEC filings and directories provide event/current-symbol information. No complete free official machine-readable PIT stock+ETF price, corporate-action, inactive-security, and delisting-return panel was verified.
us_equities.CRSP: Official product documentation supports active/inactive securities, daily/monthly history, and corporate actions; a public numeric sample/price was not verified. User permitted public sample/quote lookup only; no account, contact, or purchase was attempted.
